cd w

exec $WORK/bin/hole$GOEXE
stdout '^6/14$'
cd ..

cd neg
! logos build ./...
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
cd ..

cd view/imp
! logos build ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:10:.*const_view_mutation'
stderr 'main\.lgo:11:.*const_view_mutation'
cd ../..


-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/c/c.lgo --
package c

var owned = []int{1, 2, 3}

func Base() const []int {
	return owned
}

func Sum(xs const []int) int {
	total := 0
	for _, v := range xs {
		total += v
	}
	return total
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/q/q.go --
package q

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/c"
)

func Run() string {
	b := c.Base()
	first := c.Sum(b)
	b[0] = 9
	second := c.Sum(b)
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", first, second)
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/q"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(q.Run())
}

-- neg/go.mod --
module example.com/neg

go 1.27

-- neg/neg.lgo --
package neg

func Bad(xs const []int) {
	xs[0] = 1
}

-- view/go/go.mod --
module example.com/viewgo

go 1.27

-- view/go/take.go --
package viewgo

func Take[T any](v T) T {
	var a any = v
	return a.(T)
}

-- view/imp/go.mod --
module example.com/viewimp

go 1.27

require example.com/viewgo v1.0.0

replace example.com/viewgo => ../go

-- view/imp/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/viewgo"
)

func main() {
	s := []int{1, 2, 3}
	var view const []int = s
	_ = viewgo.Take(view)
	_ = viewgo.Take[[]int](view)
}
